name: 母親
text:
頑張ったね
連弾でもミスがなかったし、とっても上手だった
trans:
You did really great! There were no mistakes
in your performance, and you played so well!

name: 美琴
text: ……うん
trans: ...Yep.

name: 父親
text:
すごく良かったよ
練習の成果が出たんじゃないか？
trans:
That was amazing! All that practice
really paid off, didn't it?

name: 美琴
text: そうなのかな
trans: You think so?

name: 母親
text: 次の子は弾き語りなんだって
trans: The next girl will play a song cover, apparently.

name: 美琴
text: きいてもいい？
trans: Can I watch her play?

name: 母親
text: うん、戻ろっか
trans: Sure, let's go back in.

name: 美琴
text: きれい
trans: So pretty.

name: 母親
text:
なんでも食べていいからね
何が食べたい？
trans:
What do you want to eat?
You can ask for anything you want!

name: 美琴
text: ……なんでも
trans: ...Anything's fine.

name: 父親
text:
はは、なんでもか
とりあえず、適当に頼むよ
trans:
Haha, "anything" ain't on the menu! 
Just point at whatever catches your eye.

name: 母親
text:
今日はお疲れ様
初めての発表会、どうだった？
trans:
You did a great job today!
So, how did you find your first piano recital?

name: 母親
text:
大学生の子ね
きれいな歌声だった
trans:
Oh, you mean that college girl's performance?
Her singing voice was very pretty.

name: 美琴
text: 私も歌ってみたい
trans: I wanna try singing too.

name: 美琴
text: ……歌の練習、してみたい
trans: I wanna... practice singing.

name: 母親
text:
それは……習い事をしたいということ？
ピアノは辞めずに？
trans:
You mean... You want to take up singing?
While continuing your piano lessons?

name: 美琴
text:
どっちもやりたい
だめ？
trans:
I wanna do both.
...I can't?

name: 母親
text:
ううん
みーちゃんがやりたいなら、ちょっと探してみよっか
trans:
Oh, no, of course you can!
If that's what you want to do, then
we'll ask around about it, Mii-chan.

name: 美琴
text: ……うん

name: 歌の先生
text:
まずは何か歌ってみましょう
歌ってみたい曲はある？
trans:
Let's start by singing a song.
Is there any song you want to sing?

name: 美琴
text:
あります
ポップス、なんですけど──
trans:
I do.
It's a pop song, but―

name: 歌の先生
text:
うん、上手！
どうだった？　楽しかった？
trans:
Yup, well done! How do you feel?
Did you have fun?

name: 美琴
text: ……楽しい
trans: ......It's fun.

name: 歌の先生
text:
それはよかった
楽しむことが一番だからね
trans:
That's good to hear.
Having fun is the most
important thing, after all.

name: 歌の先生
text:
じゃあ、お手本
先生もちょっとだけ歌ってみるね
trans:
Alright then, I'll sing for you too just
a little bit to show you the ropes, okay?

name: 歌の先生
text:
────…………
どうだったかな
trans:
―......
Well, what do you think?

name: 美琴
text: ……上手です
trans: ......That was great.

name: 歌の先生
text:
ふふ、ありがとう
これでも東京にいた時は歌手だったんだ
trans:
Hehe, thanks!
I may not seem like it, but I was a singer
back when I was still in Tokyo.

name: 美琴
text:
やめたんですか？
どうして……
trans:
Did you stop?
Why...?

name: 歌の先生
text:
……環境が変わって
毎日練習するのが難しくなったから、かな
trans:
...Because things changed, and it got harder
for me to practice every single day, I guess.

name: 歌の先生
text:
前にできたことができなくなったり
日々調子を維持できなくなる自分が嫌で──
trans:
Things I used to be able to do became impossible
for me, and I hated myself for not being able to
stay in good condition day after day―

name: 歌の先生
text:
……あ、ごめんね
そうだ、マイクを使って歌ってみる？
trans:
...Oh, sorry about that. 
You know, why not try singing while holding a mic?

name: 美琴
text: やってみたいです
trans: I want to try that.

name: 歌の先生
text: 先生がピアノを弾くね
trans: I'll play the piano for you, then.

name: 母親
text: 今日はお世話になりました
trans: Thank you for taking care of my daughter today.

name: 歌の先生
text:
いえいえ、こちらこそ
とってもお上手でした
trans:
No problem, I should be doing the thanking.
She's very talented.

name: 美琴
text:
……あの
明日も来ていいですか
trans:
Um...
Can I come back tomorrow?

name: 歌の先生
text:
大丈夫だけど……
お母様も構わないですか？
trans:
Sure, you can, but...
Your mother wouldn't mind, would she?

name: 母親
text:
もちろん
お願いします、先生
trans:
Oh, of course not.
Please continue to take care of her, Teacher.

name: 歌の先生
text:
ありがとうございます
よろしくね
trans:
Thank you very much.
Let's see each other again tomorrow, then.

name: 美琴
text: ……よかった
trans: ......I'm so glad.

name: 美琴
text: よろしくおねがいします
trans: Please take care of me from now on.
